models.code:
class Customer(Base):
    __tablename__ = "customer"
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    name = Column(String, nullable=False)
    credit_limit = Column(Decimal, nullable=False)
    balance = Column(Decimal, nullable=False, default=0.00)
models.description: Defines the Customer entity with credit and balance attributes.
models.name: Customer

models.code:
class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = "order"
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    customer_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('customer.id'), nullable=False)
    notes = Column(String)
    date_shipped = Column(DateTime)
    amount_total = Column(Decimal, nullable=False, default=0.00)
models.description: Defines the Order entity, linked to Customer with a total amount and optional ship date.
models.name: Order

models.code:
class Item(Base):
    __tablename__ = "item"
    
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    order_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('order.id'), nullable=False)
    product_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('product.id'), nullable=False)
    unit_price = Column(Decimal, nullable=False)
    quantity = Column(Integer, nullable=False)
    amount = Column(Decimal, nullable=False, default=0.00)
models.description: Defines the Item entity, with quantity, unit_price and calculated amount.
models.name: Item

rules.name: Credit Limit Check
rules.description: Ensure Customer balance does not exceed credit limit
rules.code:
Rule.constraint(validate=Customer,
                as_condition=lambda row: row.balance <= row.credit_limit,
                error_msg="Customer balance ({row.balance}) exceeds credit limit ({row.credit_limit})")

rules.name: Sum Order Amount
rules.description: Calculate Customer balance as sum of Order amount_total where date_shipped is null
rules.code: Rule.sum(derive=Customer.balance, as_sum_of=Order.amount_total, where=lambda row: row.date_shipped is None)
